definitions.explanation: The sale of goods in large quantities to retailers or other businesses, rather than directly to consumers.

examples.japanese: {卸|おろし}{価格|かかく}で{買|か}う。
この{店|みせ}は{卸|おろし}{専門|せんもん}だから{一般|いっぱん}{客|きゃく}は{入|はい}れない。
examples.english: This store is wholesale only, so regular customers can't enter.

examples.japanese: {青果|せいか}の{卸|おろし}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}がスーパーに{野菜|やさい}を{届|とど}けている。
examples.english: The produce wholesaler delivers vegetables to the supermarket.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in compound forms. The full form {卸売|おろしうり} (wholesale selling) is also common. Contrasts with {小売|こうり} (retail).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卸売|おろしうり}: wholesale selling
- {卸|おろし}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: wholesaler
- {卸|おろし}{価格|かかく}: wholesale price
- {卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}: wholesale market
